summary: Fire tower near Thunder Bay, Ontario, removed in 2011; a reader reports only four cement anchors are left.

facts.status_note: Removed in 2011 according to firelookout.ca; a reader's comment says only four cement anchors remain.

events.note: A hiking guide's writer visited in 2010; the tower was taken down after that visit.
Firelookout.ca records the tower as removed in 2011.

evidence.supports: Location given as Thunder Bay, Ontario
Route: about 10 km down Hazelwood Drive, driveway on the right before a powerline
evidence.quote: Drive about 10km down Hazelwood Drive and take the driveway on the right, just before a powerline.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No construction date, height, design, agency or photos found: the firelookout.ca page has none, and two web searches turned up only the hiking guide and an index entry. The four-anchor remains come from a reader comment on the hiking page, which also says the anchors were dug up; treat as unverified. The 2010 visit and the removal date (2011) are consistent. Ontario tower layer (LIO OGF_ID 150724187, cached at data/raw/ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson) has a 'Fire Tower' point at 48.55276, -89.28448 with no other attributes; not cited in the story because the geohub page cannot be quote-checked. Record location matches that point within the firelookout.ca coordinates. Public access today is not stated by any source, so no access level is set.
